sentences.en: On a September evening in 2016, Terrence Crutcher's SUV stopped in the middle of a road in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 2016年9月的一个傍晚，泰伦斯·克鲁彻的SUV停在了俄克拉荷马州塔尔萨市的一条马路中间。

sentences.en: A woman saw him step out of the car.
sentences.zh: 一位女士看到他从车里走了出来。

sentences.en: The doors of the car were open.
Officer Betty Shelby was on her way to an unrelated incident when the call came in.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·谢尔比警官在接到报警时，正赶往处理另一件无关的事件。

sentences.en: Terrence was 40, African-American, born and raised in Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 泰伦斯40岁，是非裔美国人，在塔尔萨出生长大。

sentences.en: He was a church-going man with four children.
sentences.zh: 他是一位虔诚的教徒，有四个孩子。
贝蒂42岁，是白人，也是一位母亲。

sentences.en: She was born in a small town not far from Tulsa.
sentences.zh: 她出生在离塔尔萨不远的一个小镇。

sentences.en: In an ideal world, these two Oklahoma natives, close in age, ought to have had more to bring them together than hold them apart.
sentences.zh: 在理想的世界里，这两位年龄相仿的俄克拉荷马本地人，本应有更多的共同点，而不是隔阂。

sentences.en: But on this evening, there was no small talk or friendly chatter.
sentences.zh: 但就在那个傍晚，没有闲聊，也没有友好的寒暄。

sentences.en: The police officer told Terrence to take his hands out of his pockets.
sentences.zh: 警察命令泰伦斯把手从口袋里拿出来。

sentences.en: According to her attorney, he first complied.
sentences.zh: 据她的律师称，他起初照做了。

sentences.en: He then put his hands up in the air.
sentences.zh: 随后他把双手举到了空中。

sentences.en: Moments later, he put his hands back in his pockets.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，他又把手放回了口袋里。

sentences.en: By this point, multiple police officers had gathered and drawn their guns in tasers.
sentences.zh: 此时，多名警察已经聚集并拔出了枪支和泰瑟枪。

sentences.en: Overhead, a police chopper filmed events as they unfolded.
sentences.zh: 头顶上，一架警用直升机拍摄了事态发展的全过程。

sentences.en: From the video, it's hard to tell exactly what's happening on the ground.
sentences.zh: 从视频中，很难准确判断地面上到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: But an officer in the helicopter thinks Terrence isn't cooperating.
sentences.zh: 但直升机上的一名警察认为泰伦斯不配合。
我想，不像是要用泰瑟枪。

sentences.en: Moments later, one officer on the ground does fire a taser.

她打死了泰伦斯·克鲁彻。

sentences.en: Later, police discover that he was unarmed.

sentences.en: Did him being a big black man play a role in her perceived danger?

sentences.en: She's worked in this part of town for quite some time.

sentences.en: And, you know, just the week before, she was at an all-black high school homecoming football game.

sentences.en: And so it went with accusations against and defenses for the person who pulled the trigger and the person who got shot.

sentences.en: Still, the tenor of the back and forth, the psychological accusations and psychological defenses, is very revealing.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这种来回拉锯的基调，以及心理上的指责与辩护，非常发人深省。

sentences.en: When an incident like this occurs, we want to hear the story of what happened.
sentences.zh: 当此类事件发生时，我们想了解事情的真相。

sentences.en: We want to know what was going on in the mind of the shooter and the mind of the victim.
sentences.zh: 我们想知道枪手和受害者的内心在想什么。

sentences.en: Was Terrence Crutcher truly a threat?

sentences.en: Did Betty Shelby dislike black people?

sentences.en: What clues explain the behavior of these individuals?

sentences.en: We home in, dig for facts, and look for psychological explanations.
sentences.zh: 我们深入挖掘事实，寻找心理学上的解释。

sentences.en: But what if there's another way to think about what happened?

sentences.en: One that has less to do with the individuals involved,

sentences.en: and more to do with the context in which the shooting occurred.
sentences.zh: 而与枪击事件发生的背景关系更大。

sentences.en: What we're discovering here is that the individual mind sits in society,
sentences.zh: 我们在这里发现的是，个人的思想存在于社会之中，

sentences.en: and the connection between mind and society is an extremely important one that should not be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 而思想与社会之间的联系极其重要，不容忽视。

sentences.en: Mazarin is a psychology professor at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 马扎琳是哈佛大学的心理学教授。

sentences.en: She's made a career out of studying the invisible.
sentences.zh: 她以研究“无形之物”为职业。

sentences.en: For the past 30 years, I've been interested in studying those aspects of our minds
sentences.zh: 在过去的30年里，我一直致力于研究我们思想中那些

sentences.en: that are hidden from our own conscious awareness.
sentences.zh: 隐藏在我们意识之外的方面。

sentences.en: Mazarin's interest began in graduate school.
sentences.zh: 马扎琳的兴趣始于研究生时期。

sentences.en: She was teaching psychology at Yale and looking for a way to measure people's biases.
sentences.zh: 当时她在耶鲁大学教心理学，并寻找一种衡量人们偏见的方法。

sentences.en: There was debate over the right scientific method to do this.
sentences.zh: 关于采用哪种科学方法来做到这一点，当时存在争议。

sentences.en: You could simply ask people their views,
sentences.zh: 你可以直接询问人们的观点，

sentences.en: but because prejudice is a sensitive topic, you often don't get anything.
sentences.zh: 但由于偏见是一个敏感话题，你往往得不到任何结果。

sentences.en: You couldn't walk up to somebody and say,
sentences.zh: 你不能直接走到某人面前问：

sentences.en: do you agree that Italians are lazy?
sentences.zh: 你同意意大利人很懒吗？

sentences.en: And have them say yes or no.
sentences.zh: 然后让他们回答是或否。

sentences.en: They'll just refuse to answer that question.
sentences.zh: 他们只会拒绝回答这个问题。

sentences.en: Our deep-seated discomfort about discussing prejudice
sentences.zh: 我们对于讨论偏见根深蒂固的不适感，

sentences.en: was one hurdle for a researcher looking to study the phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 是研究这一现象的研究人员面临的一道障碍。

sentences.en: Mazarin realized there was another barrier.
sentences.zh: 马扎琳意识到还有另一道障碍。

sentences.en: What if some forms of prejudice are so deeply buried
sentences.zh: 如果某些形式的偏见埋藏得如此之深，

sentences.en: that people don't even realize they harbor such bias?
sentences.zh: 以至于人们甚至没有意识到自己怀有这种偏见呢？

sentences.en: Perhaps we behave in ways that are not known to our own conscious awareness,

并不是因为我们明确地带有偏见，

sentences.en: but because we may carry in our heads the thumbprint of the culture.

sentences.en: Was there a way to decipher this thumbprint and expose people's hidden biases?

sentences.en: Eventually, Mazarin, with the help of her mentor, Toni Greenwald,
sentences.zh: 最终，马扎琳在她的导师托尼·格林沃尔德，

sentences.en: and then-graduate student Brian Nozek, developed a simple, ingenious teSt.

sentences.en: It's called the Implicit Association Test, or the IAT.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“内隐联想测试”，简称IAT。

sentences.en: It's based on the way we group things in our minds.
sentences.zh: 它基于我们在大脑中对事物进行分组的方式。

sentences.en: When you say bread, my mind will easily think butter,
sentences.zh: 当你提到“面包”时，我的大脑会很容易想到“黄油”，

sentences.en: but not something unrelated to it.
sentences.zh: 而不是与之无关的东西。

sentences.en: Our brains, it turns out, make associations,
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我们的大脑会进行联想，

sentences.en: and these associations can reveal important things about the way we think.
sentences.zh: 而这些联想可以揭示我们思维方式的重要信息。

sentences.en: So the way the IAT works is to simply ask people to sort things.
sentences.zh: 所以，IAT的工作原理就是简单地要求人们对事物进行分类。
